items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: they had Ray Heatherton and Reese Stevens with a big orchestra... And I was in New York with a small combination

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
New York. And they had a group in Chicago -- they had Ray Heatherton and Reese Stevens with a big orchestra and a choir and everything singing 'Loch Lomond', and 'A Brown Bird Singing' straight.
And I was in New York with a small combination, (shivering). It ran on for quite a while.
